title: Uruguayan-Style Poached Cod with Ceviche Garnish
description: A light and refreshing Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring poached cod topped with a zesty ceviche garnish.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine water and white vinegar. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
2. Reduce heat to low and add cod fillets. Poach for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, mix lime juice, sliced red onion, and chopped cilantro in a small bowl.
4. Once cod is cooked, remove from the saucepan and place on a plate.
5. Spoon ceviche garnish over the top of the cod.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
